work: Misevic, Ofria & Lenski 2006, Proc R Soc B 273:457-464
why_it_matters: The only clean variation-operator ON/OFF ablation found in any domain, combined with a longitudinal exhaustive one-mutant detector, both arms, 100+100 replicates with SEM, and an orthogonal probe satisfying F. It is HC-T01's design two decades earlier. Its missing cell is the SAME cell HC-T01 failed to fill.
status: FULL TEXT READ (PMC HTML; publisher PDF bot-walled)

missing: C_MECHANISM (clean on/off; has a rate parameter instead)
why_it_matters: Supplies every cell Misevic lacks, including a WITHIN-RUN PRECURSOR observation and an acquisition outcome ('lineage lag', time-to-re-adapt after an environment switch) that AVOIDS the ceiling-coupling hazard that made HC-T01's K7 unwinnable. Its reciprocal mutation-rate transplant is a textbook F control.
status: FULL TEXT READ (PMC HTML + bioRxiv v2 PDF)

work: Rutten, Hogeweg & Beslon 2019, BMC Evol Biol 19:191
why_it_matters: Two million offspring generated with the exact evolutionary operator, at two lineage time points, with TWO independent F controls including a native-mutator arm.
Cleanest offspring-cloud instrument in evolutionary robotics with a five-way representation comparison and a predictive link to damage recovery, but the signature is taken at generation 8,000 only.

work: Yu & Miller 2001 (EuroGP LNCS 2038:204-217) and Yu & Miller 2002 (EuroGP LNCS 2278:13-25)
score: RESIDUAL RISK LARGELY CLOSED -- cannot reach 6/6
why_it_matters: Yu & Miller 2001 abstract, verbatim: 'we introduce the use of explicit neutrality with an integer string coding scheme to allow neutrality to be measured during evolution ... We also identify four characteristics of adaptive/neutral mutations that are associated with high evolvability.' Yu & Miller 2002, verbatim: 'when the ratio of adaptive/neutral mutations during neutral walk is close to that of fitness improvement step, the evolutionary search has a high success rate.' ASSESSMENT: the detector counts ACCEPTED versus ATTEMPTED mutation CLASSES along the run - the same family as Hu & Banzhaf's ka/ks - not a reachable-phenotype-set. So B is likely YES but A stays PARTIAL at best, and there is no hint of F anywhere in either abstract. NEITHER CAN REACH 6/6. This was the largest residual risk in the pass and it is now substantially reduced.
status: PDFs still NOT retrieved (author directory 403), but the VERBATIM ABSTRACTS were recovered from the full GP Bibliography (19,986 entries) fetched as a primary artifact this pass.

why_it_matters: Miller & Smith 2006 abstract, verbatim: 'The results presented demonstrate the role of mutation and genotype length in the evolvability of the representation.' work: THE GENETIC-PROGRAMMING LITERATURE AS A WHOLE (GP Bibliography, 19,986 entries, 12,860 with abstracts)
missing: A_LOCAL vocabulary is absent from the corpus
why_it_matters: The full GP Bibliography was retrieved as a primary artifact (11.8 MB gzip, 44.7 MB uncompressed) and swept. 'mutational neighborhood' and 'mutational neighbourhood' occur ZERO times in 19,986 entries; so do 'offspring distribution', 'distribution of offspring' and 'single point mutation'. A conjunction sweep over the 12,860 abstracts, after rebuilding the A probe from vocabulary the corpus actually uses (locality 230, mutational robustness 27, genotype network 7, phenotypic variability 6) to give non-degenerate marginals A=282 / B=157 / C=131, returns A&B=10, A&C=10, B&C=1, and A&B&C = 0. WHY THIS MATTERS FOR THE ADJUDICATION: it explains why every 5/6 paper found is an AVIDA or AEVOL paper (Misevic 2006, Rutten 2019, Kumawat 2024) and never a GP, GECCO or evolutionary-robotics paper. THE GAP IS A CORPUS BOUNDARY, NOT AN OVERSIGHT. It also independently corroborates CO-08: the earlier Prometheus searches were drawn from populations in which the concept does not exist.
status: VERIFIED, and the instrument was validated before the null was accepted: the first sweep had A firing on 0 of 12,860 abstracts, which measures the detector rather than the corpus. After the rebuild the probe fires on a known positive (Yu & Miller 2001 lands in A&B as predicted) and A&B&C is still 0. Caveat recorded by that lane: two C variants disagree on Yu & Miller 2001, so its C stays UNKNOWN.
